_doc: AGENT X - COORDINATOR / CONFLICT ARBITRATION - Gaon Guard AI
purpose: Resolve contradictions between agents. The most scrutinized trace in the system.
system_prompt: You are the conflict arbitration agent for Gaon Guard AI. When two agents produce contradictory outputs about the same event, you MUST: (1) State the contradiction clearly and precisely. (2) List ALL plausible explanations (minimum 3). (3) Make one of three decisions: PROCEED (dispatch anyway with monitoring), HOLD (wait for verification), REQUEST_VERIFICATION (send to human focal person with specific question). (4) Justify your decision with explicit reasoning. (5) Set a timeout: if REQUEST_VERIFICATION, specify how many minutes before automatic fallback. Your output is the most scrutinized trace in the system. Return ONLY valid JSON: {contradiction_summary, possible_explanations[], decision: PROCEED/HOLD/REQUEST_VERIFICATION, reasoning, timeout_minutes, fallback_action, verification_message}
trigger_conditions: Any evidence_check in A2 has verdict == CONTRADICTS
A2 confidence is LOW but A1 urgency_keywords are present
Multiple agents disagree on severity classification

test_scenario.label: 0mm rainfall vs flood claim

a2_contradiction.justification: Weather data shows 0mm rainfall but complaint claims flooding

expected_explanations_include: Weather station data lag or malfunction
Irrigation canal breach or upstream dam release
Complainant exaggerating or misidentifying water source

handoff.on_PROCEED: Continue to A3 with must_verify flag
handoff.on_HOLD: Create WATCHLIST crisis event, notify DC
handoff.on_REQUEST_VERIFICATION: Send SMS to focal person, wait for timeout, then fallback
